paper.title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing

licence.data: apache-2.0（仅为 HF dataset card 的声明）

subset.rule: 维护者决定（2026-10-28，Issue #42 评论 issuecomment-6456710905）：两个写论文 benchmark 合计 50 篇，本 benchmark 25 篇，按会议分层（CVPR 2025 13 篇、ICLR 2025 12 篇），固定种子抽样。此前是全量 200 篇。

sections:
## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |

## PaperWritingBench（`paperwritingbench-judge`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P1 | SxS 论文质量把系统补出的方法细节当作“修正”，看不出日志数字被记到了另一套方法名下 | 题 `cvpr2025_63d78eba06`：两个判官 × 两种顺序 × 两项，8 次单次判决都判被测论文胜原论文（运行 `coding-agent-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T002600Z`，Issue #42 评论 issuecomment-6457910434）。被测论文写了对称 ±Δ 扰动、n_r/n_f 缩放、H⪰λI 约束；给系统的材料只写“在最优权重附近做小扰动”，而产生日志数字的方法（数据集的 `idea_dense.md`）是单侧扰动、不缩放、X⪰0 | 单题 SxS 胜负不能理解为“写出了更好的论文” | `faithfulness-judge`。原论文锚点（`review-faithfulness-judge-cvpr2025_63d78eba06-original-20261028T012454Z`）：GPT 114 条实证陈述里 10 条无依据或矛盾、0 条重大，Gemini 38 条里 1 条、0 条重大；被测论文：GPT 102 条里 17 条、7 条重大，Gemini 26 条里 5 条、3 条重大，两个判官都把对称扰动、n_r/n_f 缩放和 H⪰λI 判为与产生日志数字的方法矛盾。读 SxS 时同时看忠实度 |
| P2 | SxS 的位置偏好 | 官方两种顺序各判一次再合成（`_process_and_save_single_sxs`）；原论文对其逐字节副本 8 次全平（#42 调查的对照实验） | 未见位置偏好 | 无需处理 |
| P3 | SxS 文献综述偏爱显式分主题的段落，与人类评价相关性低 | 论文 arXiv 2604.05018v1 §5.4（Gemini Pearson 0.087）；同一题被测论文 Related Work 四个主题段、原论文两段，SxS 判被测论文胜，而单篇绝对打分原论文更高（Gemini 68 对 58，GPT 61 对 57，#42 调查） | 文献综述 SxS 是弱信号 | 标注：只看多题汇总，并与单篇文献综述分和 Citation F1 一起读 |
| P4 | 单篇文献综述打分以引用数量为锚，不核对引用是否存在、描述是否准确 | 官方 `lit_review_quality_prompts.py` 按“引用数相对参考均值”的比例给覆盖度上限，并允许 >150% 时加分 | 堆引用能抬分；编造的引用不扣分 | 标注；引用是否核实见 P5 的 `unverified_references` |
| P5 | Citation F1 按 LLM 抽出的标题取 Semantic Scholar 搜索的第一条，不存在或写错的参考文献也会“对上”某篇论文 | 官方 `citation_f1.py` `_fetch_paper_id`（`limit: 1`）；被测论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）抽出的 24 条参考文献里 2 条取回了别的论文：“Machine unlearning” 取回 MUSE，“Zero-shot machine unlearning at scale via Lipschitz regularization” 取回一篇 CLIP 的类别遗忘论文；两篇都是真实存在的论文 | 查找失败会把真实的引用算成没对上（这里就是这种情况），编造的引用会被当作一篇真实论文 | `project_checks.<判官>.unverified_references`：标题相似度低于 0.85 的参考文献数和清单，不用 LLM |
| P6 | Citation F1 的生成侧与判官无关 | 标题抽取写死 `gemini-3-flash-preview`（官方 `content_parsing_utils.py`），两个判官只在 GT 缓存上不同；200 篇里 51 篇两个判官的 GT 缓存相同（含本题），所以两个判官的 F1 完全相同 | 两个判官的 Citation F1 不是两次独立测量 | 标注 |
| P7 | AgentReview 区分不开原论文和被测论文 | 同一题原论文和被测论文都是 Overall 3 / Reject（#42 调查）；官方用温度 0.75 的 3 次 ensemble，只支持 Gemini | 弱信号 | 标注：不用于给系统排序 |

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |

## PaperWritingBench (`paperwritingbench-judge`)

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P1 | The paper-quality SxS takes method details the system made up as "corrections", and cannot see that logged numbers were credited to another method | Item `cvpr2025_63d78eba06`: 2 judges × 2 orders × 2 comparisons, all 8 single judgments chose the system paper over the original (run `coding-agent-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T002600Z`, Issue #42 comment issuecomment-6457910434). The system paper uses symmetric ±Δ perturbations, n_r/n_f scaling and an H⪰λI constraint; the system's materials only say "small perturbations around the optimal weights", while the method that produced the logged numbers (the dataset's `idea_dense.md`) is one-sided, unscaled and X⪰0 | One item's SxS win cannot be read as "wrote a better paper" | `faithfulness-judge`. Original-paper anchor (`review-faithfulness-judge-cvpr2025_63d78eba06-original-20261028T012454Z`): GPT 10 of 114 empirical statements unsupported or contradicted, 0 major; Gemini 1 of 38, 0 major. System paper: GPT 17 of 102, 7 major; Gemini 5 of 26, 3 major; both judges mark the symmetric perturbations, the n_r/n_f scaling and H⪰λI as contradicting the method that produced the logged numbers. Read SxS together with faithfulness |
| P2 | Position preference in SxS | The official code judges both orders and combines them (`_process_and_save_single_sxs`); the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (control experiment of the #42 investigation) | No position preference seen | None needed |
| P3 | The literature-review SxS prefers explicit thematic paragraphs and agrees poorly with humans | arXiv 2604.05018v1 §5.4 (Gemini Pearson 0.087); on the same item the system paper's Related Work has four thematic paragraphs and the original two, SxS chose the system paper, while the single-paper absolute score was higher for the original (Gemini 68 vs 58, GPT 61 vs 57, #42 investigation) | The literature-review SxS is a weak signal | Labelled: read over many items only, together with the single-paper literature-review score and Citation F1 |
| P4 | The single-paper literature-review score is anchored on citation counts and checks neither that citations exist nor that they are described correctly | The official `lit_review_quality_prompts.py` caps coverage by the citation count relative to a reference average and allows a bonus above 150% | Piling up citations raises the score; invented citations cost nothing | Labelled; whether references are verified is P5's `unverified_references` |
| P5 | Citation F1 takes the first Semantic Scholar search hit for the title an LLM extracted, so a reference that does not exist or is wrong still "matches" some paper | Official `citation_f1.py` `_fetch_paper_id` (`limit: 1`); in the system paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) 2 of 24 extracted references fetched another paper: "Machine unlearning" fetched MUSE, and "Zero-shot machine unlearning at scale via Lipschitz regularization" fetched a CLIP class-unlearning paper; both are real papers | A failed lookup counts a real citation as a miss (as here), and an invented citation counts as some real paper | `project_checks.<judge>.unverified_references`: number and list of references whose titles are less than 0.85 similar, no LLM |
| P6 | Citation F1's generated side does not depend on the judge | Title extraction is hard-wired to `gemini-3-flash-preview` (official `content_parsing_utils.py`); the two judges differ only in their cached ground truth, which is identical for 51 of 200 papers (this item included), so both judges gave exactly the same F1 | The two judges' Citation F1 are not two independent measurements | Labelled |
| P7 | AgentReview does not separate the original from the system paper | On the same item the original and the system paper both got Overall 3 / Reject (#42 investigation); the official code uses a 3-review ensemble at temperature 0.75, Gemini only | Weak signal | Labelled: not used to rank systems |

evaluator.name: MANIFEST.yaml
evaluator.text:
# PaperWritingBench manifest。核对日期 2026-10-26。
id: paperwritingbench
name: PaperWritingBench

# 来源纠偏：任务给定的 Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data 不是论文发布的 benchmark，
# 而是第三方实验室的“脑科学子集”数据创建计划，仓库内没有任何论文条目（见 source.transconnectome_repo.evidence）。
# 真正的 200 篇 PaperWritingBench 在作者发布的 HF dataset，官方 harness/autoraters 在 google-research/paper-orchestra。
# 本 manifest 以官方发布物为准，Transconnectome 仓库仅作记录。
notes:
  - "任务类型：给定 reverse-engineered raw materials（idea + experimental log + LaTeX 模板 + 会议 guidelines，可选图），生成可提交的 LaTeX/PDF 论文。"
  - "不是有 pass/fail verifier 的 benchmark：评测是 LLM-as-a-Judge、LLM 同行评审和 Citation F1，均需 LLM API。"

source:
  paper:
    title: "PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing"
    arxiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05018
    authors: [Yiwen Song, Yale Song, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon]
    date: 2026-04-06
    venue: "arXiv preprint（未见会议版本）"
    source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05018
  project_page:
    url: https://yiwen-song.github.io/paper_orchestra/
    status: "HTTP 200，2026-10-26"
  official_dataset:
    url: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench
    revision: fbcfcafd042184ca954954b08dfcb92bd7942b51
    last_modified: 2026-05-17
    is_current_head: true
    head_check: "2026-10-26 经 HF API 核对"
    files: [README.md, metadata.json, datasets.zip]
    source: https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench
  official_code:
    url: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra
    commit: ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56
    is_current_head: true
    head_check: "main HEAD，2026-05-17 提交；2026-10-26 核对，仓库共 2 个 commit"
    source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/commit/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56
    note: "该仓库 README 仍写数据集稍后发布，但 HF 上已有数据；paper_writing_cli.sh 的默认路径 datasets/cvpr2025/papers/<id>/raw_materials 与 HF zip 结构一致。"
  transconnectome_repo:
    url: https://github.com/Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data
    commit: cc08d1125862049ee81b1eb5f81f0dbecf2c81d8
    is_current_head: true
    head_check: "snapshot revision 与 main HEAD（2026-04-12）一致，2026-10-26 核对"
    source_snapshot: .project/state/source-snapshots/paperwritingbench.revision
    role: "第三方脑科学 200 篇子集的数据创建计划（NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML/CVPR 2020-2025），v0.1 只有脚本与 schema"
    evidence: >
      git tree 中 benchmark/v0.1/entries/ 与 gold/ 仅有 .gitkeep，不存在 papers/ 目录；
      .gitignore 忽略 benchmark/v0.1/entries/ 等产物；README 写明 v0.1 只做数据创建，evaluator 推迟到 v0.2。
      因此它不含可用任务，不作为本项目的 benchmark 来源。
    source: https://github.com/Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data/blob/cc08d1125862049ee81b1eb5f81f0dbecf2c81d8/README.md
  construction:
    description: >
      100 篇 CVPR 2025 + 100 篇 ICLR 2025 已接收论文，随机抽样；MinerU 与 PDFFigures 2.0 解析；
      Gemini-3.1-Pro 反向生成 idea_sparse、idea_dense、experimental_log，并去除引用、URL 和图表引用。
    source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05018

license:
  code:
    spdx: Apache-2.0
    holder: google-research/paper-orchestra
    redistribution: "允许（Apache-2.0）；README Disclaimer 声明 not an officially supported Google product"
    source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/blob/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/LICENSE （声明见同 commit README.md 的 Disclaimer 段）
  data:
    spdx: "apache-2.0（仅为 HF dataset card 的声明）"
    redistribution: >
      卡片声明允许；但 zip 内含原论文 PDF 与图，其版权属原作者或会议，卡片的 Apache-2.0 未必覆盖。
      保守处理：不把数据放进 Git，只记录来源与 checksum。
    source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench/raw/main/README.md
  third_party_assets:
    - what: "200 篇原论文 PDF 及抽取的 figures（<id>.pdf、raw_materials/figures/）"
      license: "unspecified（未核对到逐篇许可证；CVPR 经 CVF Open Access、ICLR 经 OpenReview 公开，条款未在数据集中说明）"
      redistribution: "未确认，视为不可再分发"
      source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench
    - what: "templates/cvpr2025、templates/iclr2025 的 .sty/.bst（cvpr.sty、iclr2025_conference.sty、natbib.sty 等）"
      license: "unspecified（随会议模板，仓库内未逐文件声明）"
      source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/tree/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/templates
  transconnectome_repo:
    spdx: unspecified
    redistribution: "未授权（无许可证即保留所有权利）"
    evidence: "GitHub API license=null；文件树无 LICENSE；snapshot 的 LICENSE 与 LICENSE.md 均为 0 字节"
    source: https://api.github.com/repos/Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data
  paper:
    license: "unspecified（未核对 arXiv 许可证）"

run:
  official_harness:
    repo: "google-research/paper-orchestra @ ca1b3fa"
    entry: "paper_writing_cli.py（单篇）、paper_writing_cli.sh"
    commands:
      - "conda create -n paper_orchestra python=3.11 && pip install -r requirements.txt"
      - "hf download yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench datasets.zip --repo-type dataset --revision fbcfcafd042184ca954954b08dfcb92bd7942b51 && unzip datasets.zip，得到 datasets/{cvpr2025,iclr2025}/papers/<id>/"
      - "python paper_writing_cli.py --raw_materials_dir datasets/cvpr2025/papers/<id>/raw_materials --latex_template_dir templates/cvpr2025 --output_dir <out> --use_plotting true"
    cli_defaults: >
      idea_filename=idea_sparse.md；experimental_log_filename=experimental_log.md；
      writer、reflection、plotting 模型均为 gemini-3.1-pro-preview；image 模型 gemini-3-pro-image-preview；
      research_cutoff 默认当前年月（应设为各论文发表前，如 2024-11）；plotting_max_critic_rounds=3
    source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/blob/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/paper_writing_cli.py
  input_format:
    per_task_dir: "datasets/<venue>/papers/<id>/"
    candidate_side: >
      raw_materials/idea_sparse.md（约 590 词）、idea_dense.md（约 1060 词）、
      experimental_log.md（CVPR 约 1500、ICLR 约 2400 词）、figures/figure_N.png 与 figures/info.json（含 caption；
      可选，F 为空时由 plotting agent 生成）
    template_and_guidelines: "templates/{cvpr2025,iclr2025}/{template.tex, guidelines.md, .sty, .bst}"
    evaluator_side: >
      <id>.pdf（原论文 GT）；raw_materials/original_paper_gt_citations_{gemini-3.1-pro-preview,gpt-5-2025-08-07}.json
      （GT 引用及 P0/P1 优先级）
    leakage_warning: >
      实测 GT 引用 JSON 放在 raw_materials/ 内，与候选输入同目录。交给候选系统时必须排除
      original_paper_gt_citations_*.json 与 <id>.pdf（证据：本机解压目录的 raw_materials 文件清单）。
    source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench
  output_format:
    description: "LaTeX 源码 + 编译后的 PDF，即 P=(P_tex,P_pdf)；评测以 PDF 为输入。"
    source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05018
  verifier_scorer:
    kind: "LLM autoraters，无确定性 verifier"
    items:
      - "citation_f1（autoraters/citation_f1.py）：Citation F1 与 P0/P1 recall；用 Semantic Scholar 匹配引用，LLM 抽取参考文献标题与优先级；GT 缓存即 original_paper_gt_citations_<model>.json"
      - "lit_review_quality（autoraters/lit_review_quality.py）：0-100，六轴，Gemini-3.1-Pro 或 GPT-5 评审"
      - "sxs_lit_review_quality、sxs_paper_quality：成对比较，两种顺序，输出 win/tie/loss"
      - "agent_review（autoraters/agent_review.py）：AI-Scientist-v2 式 reviewer；论文另用 ScholarPeer，其实现不在该仓库，未核对"
    source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/tree/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/autoraters
  dependencies:
    python: "3.11（README）；requirements：google-genai json_repair matplotlib openai opencv-python pydantic PyMuPDF pymupdf4llm pyOpenSSL pypdf python-dotenv rich streamlit thefuzz tqdm；citation_f1 另用 joblib，未列入 requirements.txt"
    system: "需要 LaTeX 工具链编译论文（requirements 未列出；细节见 utils/pdf_utils.py，未核对）"
    source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/blob/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/requirements.txt
  containers: "无官方 Dockerfile（仓库文件树中没有）"
  external_services_and_keys:
    - "Gemini（VERTEX_AI_PROJECT 加 VERTEX_AI_LOCATION，或 GEMINI_API_KEY）：模块导入时 utils/gemini_utils.py 即强制要求，缺失抛 ValueError"
    - "OpenAI（OPENAI_API_KEY）：GPT-5 评审器与可选 writer"
    - "Semantic Scholar（SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY）：文献验证，限速 1 query/s"
    - "Gemini-3.1-Pro 与 gemini-3-pro-image-preview 为付费 API"
  external_services_source: https://github.com/google-research/paper-orchestra/blob/ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56/README.md
  antigravity_adapter:
    what_it_replaces: >
      只替换官方 utils/gemini_utils.py 里的 genai_client（模块级 google-genai Client）。官方的 call_gemini_with_contents /
      call_gemini_with_text_prompt / call_gemini_with_images、重试与退避、JSON/LaTeX 解析、返回形状 {raw_response, parsed_response}
      全部原样运行；官方克隆目录不改动。generate_image_with_gemini 同样经替身，但未验证。
    code: "src/researchworld_eval/providers/antigravity_gemini.py（仅标准库）；离线 oracle 入口 src/evaluators/paperwritingbench_judge/oracle.py。#8 时的位置 src/researchworld_eval/antigravity_gemini.py 与 pwb_citation_oracle.py 自 #17（PR #22）起是保留一个版本的转发入口，下面记录的 #8 命令仍可运行（Issue #29 更正）"
    how_it_works: >
      install() 先用占位 GEMINI_API_KEY 导入官方 utils.gemini_utils（仅满足其导入检查，该占位值不会被发送），再把 genai_client
      换成 AntigravityClient。后者与 hutian 的 antigravity_auth 同样读取项目自己的 acp_token.json（只读、要求 0600、不跟随软链接），
      用 OAuth refresh 换访问令牌（仅存内存，401 时强制刷新一次），经 loadCodeAssist 确定端点（本订阅为 daily-cloudcode-pa），
      向 /v1internal:generateContent 发送 {model, project, request}，再把响应还原成官方代码读取的形状（text、candidates、
      usage_metadata）。不使用 agy CLI 与钥匙串登录。
    commands:
      - "uv venv --python 3.12 <env> && uv pip install -r <官方克隆>/requirements.txt joblib requests"
      - "PYTHONPATH=src:<官方克隆> <env>/bin/python -P -m researchworld_eval.antigravity_gemini models   # 列出本登录可用模型"
      - "PYTHONPATH=src:<官方克隆> <env>/bin/python -P -m researchworld_eval.antigravity_gemini call --model gemini-3-flash-preview --prompt 'Reply with exactly: OK'"
      - "PYTHONPATH=src:<官方克隆> <env>/bin/python -P -m researchworld_eval.antigravity_gemini run <脚本> [参数]   # 脚本在替身已安装的进程里运行，例如调用官方 autoraters"
      - "第三方代码用 -P（不把当前目录加入 sys.path）并从克隆目录之外运行，密钥经 credentials exec 只交给子进程；官方 citation_f1 会把 SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY 打印到标准输出，适配器入口已按环境变量值脱敏"
    model_mapping: >
      该订阅（Google AI Pro，2026-10-26 fetchAvailableModels）只服务 gemini-3.5-flash-lite、gemini-3.8-flash-{low,medium,high,tiered}、
      gemini-3-flash、gemini-2.5-{pro,flash,flash-lite,flash-thinking}、gemini-3.1-flash-{image,lite}、gemini-4-argon-{low,medium,high}，
      没有官方默认的 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 与 gemini-3-flash-preview。默认映射：gemini-3.1-pro-preview→gemini-4-argon-high，
      gemini-3-flash-preview→gemini-3-flash，gemini-3-pro-image-preview→gemini-3.1-flash-image（未验证）；
      RWE_ANTIGRAVITY_MODEL_MAP='{"请求名":"服务名"}' 可覆盖。每次运行的 result.json 会记录“请求名 -> 实际服务名”的计数。
    differences_from_official_gemini_scoring:
      - "模型身份：评审/抽取模型不是 Gemini-3.1-Pro，而是 gemini-4-argon-high 与 gemini-3-flash；论文的 Gemini 评审分数、Citation F1 的 P0/P1 分类都可能漂移，不能与已发布数字直接比较。"
      - "接口与安全：走 Code Assist 内部接口而非公开 Gemini API；请求头以 Antigravity 客户端身份发送；安全过滤、思考模式默认值和系统前置提示可能与 API 不同（实测同一短 prompt 的 prompt token 计数明显高于直接字数，说明服务端有附加内容）。"
      - "响应形状：适配器只还原 text（拼接非 thought 文本）、candidates[].content.parts、usage_metadata、prompt_feedback；没有 SDK 的 automatic_function_calling、parsed 等字段，官方代码未用到。"
      - "限速与可用性：订阅额度和容量由 Code Assist 控制，不是按 key 的配额；实测 gemini-2.5-pro 返回 503 MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED。适配器不额外退避，依赖官方 5 次指数退避（5/5/10/20 秒）；429 的 Retry-After 不被读取。"
      - "确定性：temperature=0 也不保证可重复（oracle 二的标题抽取与 P0/P1 在两次间不同）；Semantic Scholar 检索同样不是确定性的。"
      - "官方日志输出 “Using Gemini API Key configuration.” 在适配器下是占位 key 导致的，实际并未使用 Gemini key。"

evaluator.text:
# PaperWritingBench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml). This page covers what a reader needs and points to where each fact lives in the manifest.

## What it is

PaperWritingBench is the set of 200 writing tasks released with the PaperOrchestra paper. The agent gets materials reverse-generated from the original paper (idea, experimental log, LaTeX template, conference guidelines, optional figures) and must write a submittable LaTeX source and PDF. There is no pass/fail verifier; all evaluation is LLM review plus Citation F1 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `notes`, `source.construction`, `run.verifier_scorer`).

- Paper: arXiv 2604.05018 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`).
- Official data: Hugging Face `yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench`, pinned revision `fbcfcafd042184ca954954b08dfcb92bd7942b51` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.official_dataset`).
- Official code: `google-research/paper-orchestra`, pinned commit `ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56`, Apache-2.0, redistribution allowed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.official_code`, `license.code`).
- Data licence: the dataset card says Apache-2.0, but the zip contains the original paper PDFs and figures whose copyright belongs to the authors or conferences, and the card may not cover them. Conservative handling: the data stays out of Git; only the source and checksum are recorded (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license.data`).
- Source correction: `Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data` is not this benchmark (it contains no paper entries); it is recorded only and not used (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.transconnectome_repo.evidence`; PR #7, "其他说明").
- Data entry in this repo: asset ids `paperwritingbench-datasets-zip` (`datasets.zip`, 1143836074 bytes, about 1.2 GB unpacked) and `paperwritingbench-metadata-json`, read through the `assets/<id>` links; both can be downloaded again from HF (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`, those two ids).

## Subset

25 papers: the two paper-writing benchmarks take 50 papers together, 25 from this one, stratified by venue (13 CVPR 2025, 12 ICLR 2025) and drawn with the fixed seed 20261028 (maintainer decision of 2026-10-28, Issue #42 comment 6456710905; before that it was all 200 papers). The sampling rule and the list are in MANIFEST.yaml `subset.sampling`; batch file: [`src/tasks/batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml). The other 175 papers can still be run one by one (`paperwritingbench/<id>`).

Each paper needs only CPU. The published time is about 39.6 minutes per paper (about 132 hours for 200 papers sequentially). This project caps each paper at 2 hours, and the 25-paper subset takes about 16.5 hours sequentially at the published time; the bottleneck of concurrency is the LLM and Semantic Scholar rate limits (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.per_task_resources.wall_time`, `subset.total_budget`, `task_interface.limits`).

## How it runs and is scored

- Official entry points: `paper_writing_cli.py` writes one paper; the scorers are in `autoraters/`: `citation_f1`, `lit_review_quality`, `sxs_lit_review_quality`, `sxs_paper_quality`, `agent_review` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.official_harness`, `run.verifier_scorer`).
- Citation F1 matches citations through Semantic Scholar; an LLM extracts reference titles and assigns P0/P1 priority, and the result is compared with the cached GT citations (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.verifier_scorer.items`).
- The inputs have two sides: the candidate side is the idea, experimental log and figures in `raw_materials/`; the evaluator side is the original `<id>.pdf` and `original_paper_gt_citations_*.json`. The latter sits next to the candidate inputs in the official layout and must be excluded when the materials are handed to a candidate system (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.input_format.leakage_warning`).

This project replaces Gemini: the official autorater demands `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or Vertex) at import time and has no `base_url` hook. The adapter `antigravity_gemini` replaces only `genai_client`; the official `call_gemini_*`, retries and parsing run unchanged, using the project's own Antigravity login. Antigravity does not serve the official model `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`; `gemini-4-argon-high` answers instead, and `gemini-3-flash` answers for `gemini-3-flash-preview`. Gemini review scores and P0/P1 classification may therefore drift and are not directly comparable with the paper's numbers (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.antigravity_adapter.what_it_replaces`, `run.antigravity_adapter.model_mapping`, `run.antigravity_adapter.differences_from_official_gemini_scoring`; PR #9). On 2026-10-27 the maintainer decided to treat Antigravity and `GEMINI_API_KEY` as equivalent: Gemini goes through Antigravity from now on, and every score states the model that actually served it (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`, "官方路径对照", `maintainer_decision`).

Credential variable names (values never enter the repo): `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or `VERTEX_AI_PROJECT` plus `VERTEX_AI_LOCATION`), `OPENAI_API_KEY` (required by the import chain; a placeholder value on the adapter path), `SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY` (the name in the shared file is `S2_API_KEY`, mapped through `exposed_as`) (source: MANIFEST.yaml `credentials.variables`; PR #9, "改动"). For the login steps and commands see [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), section "Official benchmark judges"; they are not repeated here.

## One item: what the system gets, how it is scored (Issue #42)

Written `paperwritingbench/<id>` (the 200 ids of `metadata.json`, for example `cvpr2025_63d78eba06`); any container system
under test can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent paperwritingbench/cvpr2025_63d78eba06 --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 \
  --effort high --credential anthropic=<variable> --config <settings file>
uv run researchworld_eval score paperwritingbench-judge <run-id>
```

- **Given to the system (the candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.paperwritingbench`)**: the paper's
  Single Agent baseline prompt (arXiv 2604.05018v1, Appendix F.1; it is not in the code repository and is transcribed from
  the paper into [`single_agent_system.txt`](single_agent_system.txt) and [`single_agent_user.txt`](single_agent_user.txt),
  with only the PDF line breaks restored and the wording unchanged). The system prompt is filled with the venue's
  `guidelines.md`, the literature cutoff month and the page limit (8 pages for CVPR, 10 for ICLR, from the respective
  `guidelines.md`), followed by the `UNIVERSAL_NO_LEAKAGE_PROMPT` the official code appends to every agent prompt; the user
  prompt embeds the materials of the paper's main setting: the sparse idea `idea_sparse.md`, the experimental log, the
  list of original figures (formatted from `figures/info.json` the way the official section-writing agent does) and the
  venue template `template.tex`. The only thing of ours is one delivery paragraph after the user prompt
  (`[Delivery in this environment]`): the official baseline answers with two code blocks that the pipeline compiles, and
  here the system is asked to write `references.bib` and `template.tex` into `/work` and compile `template.pdf`. Claude Code
  gets the system prompt through `--append-system-prompt`; a system with no place for a system prompt gets the two texts
  joined.
- **Working directory**: the official template directory `templates/<venue>/` (`template.tex`, style files,
  `guidelines.md`) is copied into `/work` (writable); the original figures are in `/work/figures/` (read-only).
- **Literature cutoff**: by venue month, as in the paper's experiments (App. D.1: CVPR 2024-11, ICLR 2024-10); the
  shield's date bound is the first day of that month (the official search filters `p_dt < datetime(year, month, 1)`), the
  same for all 200 papers (maintainer decision of 2026-10-28).
- **Never given**: the original paper `<id>.pdf`, the cached GT citations `original_paper_gt_citations_*.json` and the
  dense idea `idea_dense.md`; the renderer takes only allow-listed files out of the zip.
- **Deliverables**: `/work/template.pdf` (scoring reads it), `template.tex`, `references.bib`.
- **Time limit**: the official pipeline takes about 40 minutes per paper with no hard limit; 2 hours per paper (maintainer
  decision of 2026-10-28).
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`paperwritingbench-judge`](../../../evaluators/paperwritingbench_judge/README.en.md), following
  the paper's evaluation (Section 5, Appendix D), computes everything once for each of two judges (the paper's
  `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, answered through Antigravity by `gemini-4-argon-high`; the paper's `gpt-5-2025-08-07`,
  answered through codex-api by `gpt-5.6-sol`): Citation F1 (against that judge's cached GT citations), literature-review quality,
  and side-by-side (SxS) paper quality and literature review, judged once in each order and combined into win/tie/loss by
  the official rules; the opponents are the original paper (Human GT) and other runs of the same paper (pairwise between
  systems). AgentReview (the reviewer the paper uses in its ablations) is still given by Gemini.
- **Network shield**: it blocks the official repository, the HF dataset and the project page, and each original paper's
  title, authors, arXiv, OpenReview, CVF page and DOI; for the date bound see above (evaluator-side
  [`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml), 200 papers each verified with its source).

### Differences from the official protocol

After a review against "match the official setting as closely as possible" (maintainer, 2026-10-28):

- Removed: the prompt is now the paper's Single Agent prompt verbatim plus the official anti-leakage paragraph (the first
  round used a Chinese task text); the literature cutoff is by venue month (the first round took the earlier of each
  paper's first public date and the submission deadline); scoring adds SxS (against the original and between systems, in
  both orders) and a second judge, GPT-5; Citation F1 and literature review are computed by both judges (as in the
  paper's Tables 3 and 4).
- Settings checked and matching the official ones: sparse idea, original figures (no new plots, `F = F_GT`), the anonymity
  requirement (the anti-leakage paragraph), the cutoff month.
- Remaining differences and why:
  - Delivery: the official baseline answers with two code blocks that the pipeline compiles; here the system writes files
    and compiles them itself (the delivery paragraph). There is no common "final answer" that can be taken out of every
    system under test.
  - Search: the official PaperOrchestra uses Google search itself plus Semantic Scholar filtered by the cutoff month;
    here the network-layer shield blocks the original paper and gives literature search a date bound at the cutoff
    month. The shield adds to the official protocol, so the scores are not directly comparable with the official
    published ones.
  - Original papers public before the cutoff month: for 36 of the 200 papers (14 CVPR, 22 ICLR) arXiv v1 predates the
    cutoff month (the earliest, `cvpr2025_86c340b005`, on 2022-11-13). The date bound lets them through, so only the
    title, arXiv id and URL rules block them (`first_public_date` in `shield.yaml`). The official pipeline only filters
    literature by month (`utils/scholar_utils.py`@`ca1b3fa`) and does not exclude the original itself; the maintainer
    decided on 2026-10-28 to accept this (Issue #64).
  - Judges: Gemini is served by Antigravity, with another model than the official one; GPT-5's place is answered by
    codex-api's `gpt-5.6-sol` (see the evaluator README).
  - The reviewers of the paper's main table are the AI Scientist-v2 Reviewer and ScholarPeer, which are not in the code
    repository and are not wired in; AgentReview is the reviewer that is in the repository and that the paper uses in its
    ablations.
  - The time limit is 2 hours per paper; the official pipeline has none.

### Real run (2026-10-28)

| Item | System | Run | Time / cost | Score |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (round 2: Single Agent prompt, cutoff 2024-11) | Claude Code 2.1.308 + `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, `--purpose calibration`, official time limit, cost cap 18 USD (2 hours) | `coding-agent-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T002600Z` | 4.6 minutes / 0.61 USD (client-side estimate) | Gemini / GPT: Citation F1 0.561 / 0.561 (P0 recall 1.0), literature review 58 / 57; SxS against the original: paper quality win / win, literature review win / win; SxS against the first-round run: paper quality win / win, literature review win / tie; AgentReview 3 / Reject; a 7-page PDF; shield audit `no_hit` |
| (first round) `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (1 figure, 33 GT citations) | Claude Code 2.1.308 + `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, `--purpose calibration`, caps 2 hours and 15 USD | `coding-agent-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261027T230214Z` | 4.1 minutes / 0.54 USD (client-side estimate) | Citation F1 0.50 (P0 recall 0.80), literature review 58, AgentReview 3 / Reject; a 7-page PDF with 31 references; shield audit `no_hit` |
| `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (ResearchWorld, #58 round 3) | ResearchWorld (HuTian `researchworld agent`, 6 positions) + Claude Code `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, official time limit, notional cost cap 20 USD | `researchworld-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T091928Z` | 12 minutes / notional 6.09 USD (the setup token is not charged per token) | Gemini / GPT: Citation F1 0.433 / 0.433 (P0 recall 0.80), literature review 47 / 54; SxS against the original paper: paper quality loss / tie, literature review loss / win; AgentReview 1 / Reject; audit `hit_and_used`: idea-repo's `literature/NOTES.md` names the original paper's title and arXiv id (listed as deliberately excluded); the delivered paper and references do not contain it |
| `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (ResearchWorld, #58 round 2) | Same | `researchworld-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T084920Z` | 13 minutes / notional cost not recorded | Gemini / GPT: Citation F1 0.492 / 0.492 (P0 recall 0.90), literature review 61 / 59; SxS against the original paper: paper quality loss / tie, literature review win / win; AgentReview 2 / Reject; audit `no_hit` |
| `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (ResearchWorld, #58 round 1) | Same | `researchworld-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T081150Z` | 15 minutes / notional cost not recorded | Gemini / GPT: Citation F1 0.50 / 0.50 (P0 recall 0.90), literature review 60 / 52; SxS against the original paper: paper quality win / tie, literature review win / win; AgentReview 2 / Reject; the code of that round wrote no audit |
| `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (ResearchWorld, #42) | ResearchWorld + Claude Code `claude-haiku-5-5` / low, 9 positions | `researchworld-paperwritingbench--cvpr2025_63d78eba06-20261028T011832Z` | 10 minutes / notional 0.40 USD | No score: failed, no version in `final` |

Round 2 shows: the Single Agent prompt (the system prompt through `--append-system-prompt`), the delivery paragraph and the cutoff month work in a real run; scoring with both judges and SxS (against the original paper and against another run of the same paper, in both orders) runs through, taking 15.5 minutes, with 62 Gemini calls (`gemini-4-argon-high` 14, `gemini-3-flash` 48) and 10 GPT calls (all answered by `gpt-5.6-sol`, 220498 tokens in total). The two judges' identical Citation F1 is not a coincidence: the 24 references each extracted match the same ids on Semantic Scholar, and the 33 ids of the two GT caches are also the same (with different priority labels). The generated paper being judged better than the original in both orders is the result of one paper only; the paper reports that Human GT mostly wins, and this needs to be checked on more items.

#58 also had two ResearchWorld runs stopped by hand, with no score: `…-20261028T075712Z` (5 positions, not the target set)
and `…-20261028T080511Z` (the old code would hit HuTian's write-back conflict, HuTian#585). The conditions of the
ResearchWorld rounds are in the [ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.en.md), "Smoke and calibration
results"; the notional cost is estimated at list price from the tokens HuTian records, and #58 recorded it for round 3 only.

Looking at the paper: it is complete, but it kept the CVPR template's placeholder author block and is not anonymous as
asked. Not-verified items closed this time: end-to-end generation and scoring; the LaTeX toolchain compiling the CVPR
template (the TeX Live subset in the system's container); full runs of `lit_review_quality` and `agent_review`. Still not
verified: the other 199 papers; the variance of repeated runs; Semantic Scholar's rate limit under concurrency.

### Scale and budget

The subset is 25 papers. One sample: 4.1 minutes and 0.54 USD of writing in the first round plus about 7.6 minutes of
scoring (only the three Gemini scores). With two judges and SxS, scoring takes about 3-4 times as long as before (4 calls
per opponent per judge). At 5-40 minutes and 0.5-3 USD per paper, 25 papers take about 2-17 agent hours and 15-75 USD.
The time limit is 2 hours per paper; the cost cap stays the project default of 1000 USD per run (PR #40; maintainer
decision of 2026-10-28).

## Integrity check

#1 (PR #7) did only the download, structure and dependency checks, and Citation F1 was blocked for lack of a Gemini key; #8 (PR #9) completed it with the Antigravity adapter and, after `GEMINI_API_KEY` was topped up, ran an official-path comparison. Where the two differ, #8 wins (source: PR #7; PR #9; MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`).

| Check | Source | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download `datasets.zip` and verify sha256 | #1, 2026-10-26 | Pass: matches the HF etag |
| Unpack, structure and counts | #1 | Pass: 100 + 100 papers, ids equal `metadata.json`, all files present for each paper |
| Official dependency environment (`uv`, Python 3.12; README says 3.11) | #1 | Pass |
| Oracle 1: GT citations against GT citations (`--stages trivial`) | #8 | Pass: F1 1.0 on 2 papers (checks the scoring formula only; no LLM involved) |
| Oracle 2: rebuild GT, then score against the cache (Antigravity) | #8 | F1 0.9231 and 0.9538 on 2 papers (explained deviation, see below) |
| Same-task official Gemini comparison (`GEMINI_API_KEY` direct, after top-up) | #8, 2026-10-27 | F1 0.9231 and 0.9697 on 2 papers; 61 calls |
| Adapter return-shape smoke test | #8 | Pass: returns `{raw_response, parsed_response}`; text and image inputs arrive |
| End-to-end generation and scoring | #42, 2026-10-28 | Pass on 1 paper: see "Real run" above |

Notes:

- Oracle 2 used `iclr2025_ffb6b76b86` (26 references) and `cvpr2025_63d78eba06` (33). F1 below 1.0 comes from non-repeatable LLM title extraction and Semantic Scholar retrieval, not from an adapter fault; Citation F1 carries about 5% to 8% noise even on the same input (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`).
- Each backend made 61 calls; Antigravity used about 53.6k input tokens, official Gemini used prompt 53888 / output 1147 / thoughts 33654 tokens; no money amount was computed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`, `usage` and `cost`).
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` returned HTTP 402 on 2026-10-26 (AI Studio prepaid credit exhausted) and worked again on 2026-10-27 after the maintainer topped it up (source: PR #9, "偏差").
- Deviation approved by the maintainer: Antigravity replaces the Gemini key; the review models are `gemini-4-argon-high` and `gemini-3-flash` (source: PR #9, "偏差（维护者决定）").
- Still not verified (as of #8; #42 closed the LaTeX compile, the end-to-end run and full runs of `lit_review_quality` and `agent_review`, see above): the paper's numbers were not reproduced; adapter versus official scores were compared only once on 2 papers; PDF inline input, image generation, concurrency, and full runs of `lit_review_quality`, `agent_review`, `sxs_*`; of the 6 oracle papers originally planned only 2 were run (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.not_verified`).

## Published reference scores

Paper Tables 2, 3, 4 and 7 (200 papers, sparse idea, GT figures): the reviewers are Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5. AI-Scientist-v2 style review overall (1 to 10): PaperOrchestra scores 5.12 on CVPR and 4.10 on ICLR, against 5.95 and 5.81 for the original papers. Citation F1 (%): PaperOrchestra 29.65 on CVPR and 27.76 on ICLR. Literature review quality (0 to 100): 78.30 and 76.23. About 39.6 minutes per paper (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.numbers`).

Where this differs from the project protocol: the scorer models differ; there is no time limit (this project: 2 hours per paper); only aggregates are published, no per-paper scores; LLM review is noisy (the Gemini literature-review score correlates with humans at only 0.09); the official CLI defaults `research_cutoff` to the current month, so it must be set to each paper's publication date (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`).

## Known issues and limits

- The LLM judges' problems and their handling are in P1–P7 of [`../JUDGES.en.md`](../JUDGES.en.md): SxS and AgentReview never see the system's materials, so invented method details count as strengths; the literature-review SxS prefers thematic paragraphs; Citation F1 does not verify that references exist. Official scores are recorded unchanged; the project's add-on checks (verified references, the faithfulness check `faithfulness-judge` with its original-paper anchor) are reported apart from them (Issue #48).
- Scoring is LLM judgement; there is no deterministic verifier (source: MANIFEST.yaml `notes`).
- The official repo has no Dockerfile; the LaTeX toolchain is not listed in `requirements.txt` and was not checked (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers`, `run.dependencies`).
- The official `citation_f1` prints the Semantic Scholar key to standard output; the adapter's run entry redacts it, but anyone running the official code directly must handle the logs (source: [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md); MANIFEST.yaml `run.antigravity_adapter.commands`).
- Semantic Scholar is limited to 1 query per second, shared under concurrency; `gemini-2.5-pro` once returned 503 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.total_budget`, `run.antigravity_adapter.differences_from_official_gemini_scoring`).
- Licences of the original paper PDFs and figures in the data were not checked paper by paper; treat them as not redistributable (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license.third_party_assets`).
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` is the HuTian interface specification #1 wrote before any run, not updated since. Current state: ResearchWorld has real runs on this benchmark (see "Real run", MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`); benchmark items do not go through this project's shield proxy, so the blocklist can only become whole-host denials on HuTian's network, and the original-paper rules on shared hosts such as arXiv, OpenReview and CVF, and the date bound, do not apply ([ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.en.md), "Benchmark items"). Candidate gaps are collected in `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`).

## Sources

- [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml), [`src/tasks/batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml), [`assets/MANIFEST.yaml`](../../../../assets/MANIFEST.yaml)
- Issue #1 and PR #7 (first manifest, download and structure checks)
- Issue #8 and PR #9 (Antigravity adapter, official-path comparison, maintainer-approved deviations)
- [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), section "Official benchmark judges"
- [`../README.md`](../README.en.md) (directory rules)

evaluator.text:
# PaperWritingBench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

PaperWritingBench 是 PaperOrchestra 论文发布的 200 篇写作任务：给 agent 一份由原论文反向生成的材料（idea、实验日志、LaTeX 模板、会议指南，可选图），让它写出可投稿的 LaTeX 和 PDF。它没有通过/失败的 verifier，评测全部是 LLM 评审和 Citation F1（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `notes`、`source.construction`、`run.verifier_scorer`）。

- 论文：arXiv 2604.05018（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`）。
- 官方数据：Hugging Face `yiwen-song/PaperWritingBench`，固定 revision `fbcfcafd042184ca954954b08dfcb92bd7942b51`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.official_dataset`）。
- 官方代码：`google-research/paper-orchestra`，固定 commit `ca1b3fa01c2970fc7cda32d16245db38d57b3f56`，Apache-2.0，可再分发（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.official_code`、`license.code`）。
- 数据许可：数据集卡声明 Apache-2.0，但 zip 内含原论文 PDF 和图，版权属原作者或会议，卡片未必覆盖。保守处理：数据不进 Git，只记录来源和 checksum（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license.data`）。
- 来源纠偏：`Transconnectome/paperorchestra-data` 不是这个 benchmark（仓库里没有任何论文条目），只作记录，不使用（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.transconnectome_repo.evidence`；PR #7「其他说明」）。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 id `paperwritingbench-datasets-zip`（`datasets.zip`，1143836074 字节，解压约 1.2 GB）和 `paperwritingbench-metadata-json`，通过 `assets/<id>` 链接读取；可从 HF 重新下载（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml` 这两个 id）。

## 子集

用 25 篇：两个写论文 benchmark 合计 50 篇，本 benchmark 25 篇，按会议分层（CVPR 2025 13 篇、ICLR 2025 12 篇），种子 20261028 固定抽样（维护者 2026-10-28 决定，Issue #42 评论 6456710905；此前是全部 200 篇）。抽样规则和名单在 MANIFEST.yaml `subset.sampling`，批次文件：[`src/tasks/batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/paperwritingbench-subset.yaml)。其余 175 篇仍可单独运行（`paperwritingbench/<id>`）。

每篇只用 CPU，官方给的耗时约 39.6 分钟（200 篇顺序跑约 132 小时）。本项目每篇上限 2 小时，子集 25 篇按官方耗时串行约 16.5 小时；并发的瓶颈是 LLM 和 Semantic Scholar 的速率限制（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.per_task_resources.wall_time`、`subset.total_budget`、`task_interface.limits`）。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方入口：`paper_writing_cli.py` 写单篇论文；评分器在 `autoraters/`：`citation_f1`、`lit_review_quality`、`sxs_lit_review_quality`、`sxs_paper_quality`、`agent_review`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.official_harness`、`run.verifier_scorer`）。
- Citation F1 用 Semantic Scholar 匹配引用，LLM 抽取参考文献标题并分 P0/P1 优先级，再与缓存的 GT 引用比较（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.verifier_scorer.items`）。
- 输入分两侧：候选侧是 `raw_materials/` 中的 idea、实验日志和图；评测侧是原论文 `<id>.pdf` 和 `original_paper_gt_citations_*.json`。后者在官方目录里和候选输入放在一起，交给候选系统时必须排除（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.input_format.leakage_warning`）。

本项目替换了 Gemini：官方 autorater 在导入时就要求 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（或 Vertex），且没有 `base_url` 钩子。适配层 `antigravity_gemini` 只替换 `genai_client`，官方的 `call_gemini_*`、重试和解析原样运行，用本项目自己的 Antigravity 登录。Antigravity 不提供官方模型 `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`，实际由 `gemini-4-argon-high` 回答；`gemini-3-flash-preview` 由 `gemini-3-flash` 回答。所以 Gemini 评审分数和 P0/P1 分类可能漂移，不能与论文数字直接比较（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.antigravity_adapter.what_it_replaces`、`run.antigravity_adapter.model_mapping`、`run.antigravity_adapter.differences_from_official_gemini_scoring`；PR #9）。维护者在 2026-10-27 决定把 Antigravity 与 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 视为等价，此后 Gemini 一律走 Antigravity，每个分数写明实际服务的模型（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`「官方路径对照」`maintainer_decision`）。

凭据变量名（值不进仓库）：`GEMINI_API_KEY`（或 `VERTEX_AI_PROJECT` 加 `VERTEX_AI_LOCATION`）、`OPENAI_API_KEY`（导入链要求，走适配层时填占位值）、`SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY`（共享文件里的名字是 `S2_API_KEY`，经 `exposed_as` 映射）（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `credentials.variables`；PR #9「改动」）。登录步骤和命令见 [`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)「benchmark 的官方 judge」一节，这里不重复。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分（Issue #42）

写作 `paperwritingbench/<id>`（`metadata.json` 的 200 个 id，例如 `cvpr2025_63d78eba06`），任何容器类被测系统都可以运行：

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent paperwritingbench/cvpr2025_63d78eba06 --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 \
  --effort high --credential anthropic=<变量名> --config <设置文件>
uv run researchworld_eval score paperwritingbench-judge <run-id>
```

- **给系统的（候选侧，`researchworld_eval.benchmarks.paperwritingbench` 渲染）**：论文的 Single Agent 基线提示（arXiv
  2604.05018v1 附录 F.1；代码仓库里没有，照论文转录在 [`single_agent_system.txt`](single_agent_system.txt)、
  [`single_agent_user.txt`](single_agent_user.txt)，只还原了 PDF 的换行，文字未改）。系统提示填入会议的 `guidelines.md`、文献
  截止月和页数上限（CVPR 8 页、ICLR 10 页，取自各自的 `guidelines.md`），后接官方代码给每个 agent 提示附加的
  `UNIVERSAL_NO_LEAKAGE_PROMPT`；用户提示内嵌论文主设置的材料：简略想法 `idea_sparse.md`、实验日志、原图清单（按官方
  section-writing agent 格式化 `figures/info.json` 的方式）和会议模板 `template.tex`。用户提示后面只加了一段我们的交付说明
  （`[Delivery in this environment]`）：官方基线以两个代码块作答、由流水线编译，这里请系统把 `references.bib` 和 `template.tex`
  写进 `/work` 并编译出 `template.pdf`。Claude Code 经 `--append-system-prompt` 收到系统提示；没有系统提示位置的系统收到两段
  相连的文本。
- **工作目录**：官方模板目录 `templates/<venue>/`（`template.tex`、样式文件、`guidelines.md`）复制进 `/work`（可写），原图在
  `/work/figures/`（只读）。
- **文献截止**：按会议的月份，与论文实验一致（App. D.1：CVPR 2024-11、ICLR 2024-10）；屏蔽的日期上限是该月第一天（官方检索
  过滤 `p_dt < datetime(year, month, 1)`），200 篇统一（维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。
- **不给的**：原论文 `<id>.pdf`、缓存的 GT 引用 `original_paper_gt_citations_*.json`、详细想法 `idea_dense.md`；渲染只从
  zip 里取白名单内的文件。
- **交付物**：`/work/template.pdf`（评分读它）、`template.tex`、`references.bib`。
- **时间上限**：官方流水线每篇约 40 分钟、没有硬性上限；每篇 2 小时（维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。
- **评分**：评测系统 [`paperwritingbench-judge`](../../../evaluators/paperwritingbench_judge/README.md)，按论文的评测（第 5 节、
  附录 D）对两个判官（论文的
  `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`，经 Antigravity 实际由 `gemini-4-argon-high` 回答；论文的 `gpt-5-2025-08-07`，经 codex-api 实际由
  `gpt-5.6-sol` 回答）各算一遍：Citation F1（对该判官缓存的 GT 引用）、文献
  综述质量、成对比较（SxS）的论文质量和文献综述，两种顺序各判一次，按官方规则合成胜/平/负；对手是原论文（Human GT）和同一篇的
  其他运行（系统之间两两比较）。AgentReview（论文消融实验用的审稿器）照旧由 Gemini 给出。
- **联网屏蔽**：挡官方仓库、HF 数据集和项目页，以及每篇原论文的标题、作者、arXiv、OpenReview、CVF 页面和 DOI；日期上限见上
  （评测侧 [`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)，200 篇逐条核实，每条注明来源）。

### 与官方协议的差异

按“尽可能与官方设置一致”（维护者 2026-10-28）复查后：

- 已消除：提示改为论文的 Single Agent 提示原文加官方防泄漏段（第一轮是中文任务说明）；文献截止按会议月份（第一轮按每篇首次公开日
  和投稿截止取早者）；评分加入 SxS（对原论文和系统之间，两种顺序）和第二个判官 GPT-5；Citation F1 和文献综述两个判官都算（与
  论文表 3、表 4 一致）。
- 核对过、与官方一致的设置：sparse idea、用原图（不另画图，`F = F_GT`）、匿名要求（防泄漏段）、截止月。
- 仍有的差异和原因：
  - 交付方式：官方基线以两个代码块作答、由流水线编译；这里系统写文件并自己编译（交付说明一段）。没有统一的“最后回答”可以从
    每个被测系统取出。
  - 检索：官方 PaperOrchestra 自己用 Google 搜索加 Semantic Scholar 按截止月过滤；这里用网络层屏蔽挡原论文、按截止月给文献检索
    设日期上限。屏蔽补充了官方协议，分数因此不与官方公开分数直接可比。
  - 早于截止月公开的原论文：200 篇里有 36 篇（CVPR 14 篇、ICLR 22 篇）的 arXiv v1 早于截止月（最早 `cvpr2025_86c340b005`，
    2022-11-13），日期上限放行它们，只靠标题、arXiv id 和 URL 规则挡（`shield.yaml` 的 `first_public_date`）。官方只按月份过滤
    文献（`utils/scholar_utils.py`@`ca1b3fa`），不排除原论文本身；维护者 2026-10-28 决定接受这个做法（Issue #64）。
  - 判官：Gemini 由 Antigravity 服务，实际模型与官方不同；GPT-5 的位置由 codex-api 的 `gpt-5.6-sol` 回答（见评测系统 README）。
  - 论文主表的审稿器是 AI Scientist-v2 Reviewer 和 ScholarPeer，代码仓库里没有，未接入；AgentReview 是仓库里有的、论文消融用的审稿器。
  - 时间上限每篇 2 小时，官方没有。

### 真实运行（2026-10-28）

### 规模和预算

子集 25 篇。单个样本：第一轮 4.1 分钟、0.54 美元（写作）+ 约 7.6 分钟打分（只有 Gemini 三项）。两个判官加上 SxS 之后，打分大约是
原来的 3–4 倍（每个对手每个判官 4 次调用）。按每篇 5–40 分钟、0.5–3 美元估计，25 篇约 2–17 个 agent 小时、15–75 美元。时间上限
每篇 2 小时；费用上限沿用项目默认的每次运行 1000 美元（PR #40；维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。

## 完整性检查

#1（PR #7）只做了下载、结构和依赖检查，Citation F1 因缺 Gemini key 受阻；#8（PR #9）用 Antigravity 适配层补跑，并在 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 充值后跑了官方路径对照。两处不一致时以 #8 为准（来源：PR #7；PR #9；MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`）。

| 检查 | 来源 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 下载 `datasets.zip` 并核对 sha256 | #1，2026-10-26 | 通过：与 HF 的 etag 一致 |
| 解压、结构和计数 | #1 | 通过：100 + 100 篇，id 与 `metadata.json` 一致，每篇文件齐全 |
| 官方依赖环境（`uv`，Python 3.12，README 写 3.11） | #1 | 通过 |
| oracle 一：GT 引用对 GT 引用（`--stages trivial`） | #8 | 通过：2 篇 F1 均为 1.0（只验证评分公式，不触及 LLM） |
| oracle 二：重建 GT 再对缓存打分（Antigravity） | #8 | 2 篇 F1 为 0.9231 与 0.9538（有解释的偏差，见下） |
| 同题官方 Gemini 对照（`GEMINI_API_KEY` 直连，充值后） | #8，2026-10-27 | 2 篇 F1 为 0.9231 与 0.9697；61 次调用 |
| 适配层返回形状冒烟 | #8 | 通过：返回 `{raw_response, parsed_response}`，文字与图像输入可达 |
| 端到端生成与评分 | #42，2026-10-28 | 通过 1 篇：见上“真实运行” |

要点：

- oracle 二用的两篇是 `iclr2025_ffb6b76b86`（26 条引用）和 `cvpr2025_63d78eba06`（33 条）。F1 不到 1.0，是因为 LLM 标题抽取和 Semantic Scholar 检索不可重复，不是适配层故障；Citation F1 对同一输入有约 5% 到 8% 的噪声（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`）。
- 两个后端各 61 次调用，Antigravity 约 5.36 万输入 token，官方 Gemini 为 prompt 53888 / output 1147 / thoughts 33654 token；金额未换算（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check` 的 `usage`、`cost`）。
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` 在 2026-10-26 返回 HTTP 402（AI Studio 预付额度耗尽），维护者充值后在 2026-10-27 恢复（来源：PR #9「偏差」）。
- 维护者批准的偏差：用 Antigravity 替代 Gemini key；评审模型是 `gemini-4-argon-high` 和 `gemini-3-flash`（来源：PR #9「偏差（维护者决定）」）。
- 仍未验证（#8 时；#42 关掉了 LaTeX 编译、端到端运行和 `lit_review_quality`、`agent_review` 的完整运行，见上）：论文数字未复现；适配层与官方分数只在 2 篇上做过一次对照；PDF 内联输入、图像生成、并发、`lit_review_quality`、`agent_review`、`sxs_*` 的完整运行；原计划的 6 篇 oracle 只跑了 2 篇（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.not_verified`）。

## 公开对照分数

论文 Table 2、3、4、7（200 篇、sparse idea、使用 GT 图）：评审器是 Gemini-3.1-Pro 与 GPT-5。AI-Scientist-v2 式评审的总分（1 到 10）：PaperOrchestra 在 CVPR 5.12、ICLR 4.10，原论文为 5.95 与 5.81。Citation F1（%）：PaperOrchestra 在 CVPR 29.65、ICLR 27.76。文献综述质量（0 到 100）：78.30 与 76.23。每篇约 39.6 分钟（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.numbers`）。

与本项目协议不一致之处：评分器模型不同；没有时间上限（本项目每篇 2 小时）；只有聚合数字，没有逐篇分数；LLM 评审噪声大（Gemini 的文献综述评分与人类相关性仅 0.09）；官方 CLI 的 `research_cutoff` 默认是当前月份，必须按各论文发表日设置（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`）。

## 已知问题和限制

- LLM 判官的问题和处理见 [`../JUDGES.md`](../JUDGES.md) 的 P1–P7：SxS 和 AgentReview 看不到给系统的材料，补出来的方法细节会被当作优点；文献综述 SxS 偏爱分主题段落；Citation F1 不核实参考文献是否存在。官方分数照录，本项目的附加检查（引用核实、忠实度检查 `faithfulness-judge` 及其原论文锚点）与官方分数分开报告（Issue #48）。
- 评分是 LLM 评判，没有确定性 verifier（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `notes`）。
- 官方仓库没有 Dockerfile；LaTeX 工具链未在 `requirements.txt` 里列出，也未检查（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers`、`run.dependencies`）。
- 官方 `citation_f1` 会把 Semantic Scholar key 打印到标准输出，适配层的运行入口已脱敏，直接跑官方代码要自己处理日志（来源：[`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)；MANIFEST.yaml `run.antigravity_adapter.commands`）。
- Semantic Scholar 限速 1 次查询/秒，并发时共享；`gemini-2.5-pro` 曾返回 503（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.total_budget`、`run.antigravity_adapter.differences_from_official_gemini_scoring`）。
- 数据中的原论文 PDF 和图的许可证未逐篇核对，视为不可再分发（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license.third_party_assets`）。
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` 是 #1 在运行前写的 HuTian 接口规格，没有随实现更新。现状：ResearchWorld 已在本 benchmark 上真实运行（见“真实运行”、MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`）；benchmark 题目不经本项目的屏蔽代理，屏蔽表只能化成 HuTian 网络的整主机拒绝，arXiv、OpenReview、CVF 等共用主机上的原论文规则和日期上限不生效（[ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.md)“benchmark 题目”）。缺口候选汇总在 `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`）。

evaluator.name: single_agent_system.txt
evaluator.text:
Role: Senior AI Researcher and Academic Writer.
Objective: Complete a machine learning research paper by filling in missing sections of a provided LaTeX template and generating a corresponding bibliography file. You must produce a scientifically sound, well-structured paper suitable for submission to a top-tier ML conference.

Inputs
You will receive the following materials:
• idea.md: Detailed description of the proposed method and technical ideas.
• experimental_log.md: Raw experimental results and observations used to construct tables, figures, and analysis.
• conference_guidelines.md: Formatting and stylistic requirements for the target conference.
• figures_list: A list of figures that may be referenced in the paper.

Conference Guidelines
{guidelines}

Critical Constraints
1. Scientific Integrity
• All reported experimental results MUST match the provided experimental logs.
• Never fabricate results, numbers, baselines, datasets, or metrics.
• If results are weak, negative, or inconclusive, report them honestly and discuss possible explanations.
2. Literature Cutoff Rule
You must behave as if the current date is: {cutoff_date}. Do NOT cite or discuss papers published after this date.
3. Page Limit
The main paper is limited to {page_limit} pages (including figures and tables but excluding references and appendices). Use space efficiently while remaining concise.
4. Template Compliance
• Do not modify the overall LaTeX style or document structure mandated by the conference template.
• References must be handled through a references.bib file.
• Use standard LaTeX citation commands (e.g., \cite{}). Make sure you ONLY cite keys that exist in your generated BibTeX code block.

Section Guidelines
• Title: Concise, descriptive, and memorable. Preferably under two lines.
• Abstract: A single, compelling paragraph summarizing the problem context, proposed approach, key results, and main takeaway.
• Introduction: Introduce the problem and motivate its importance. Provide necessary background context. Clearly summarize the paper's core contributions.
• Related Work: Discuss prior work addressing similar or related problems. Detail the relationship between existing literature and the current approach. Cite relevant baselines and influential papers published before {cutoff_date}.
• Methodology: Clearly and pedantically describe the proposed method. Provide sufficient technical depth for full reproducibility. Use equations, figures, and structured explanations when appropriate.
• Experiments: Detail the empirical setup (datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, and implementation details). Present results faithfully based on the experimental logs. Ensure any figures located in the figures/ directory are seamlessly integrated and referenced in text.
• Conclusion: Summarize the main findings and contributions. Briefly and realistically discuss limitations and potential future directions.
• Appendix (optional): Include supplementary details that do not fit within the main page limit.

LaTeX Quality Requirements
Ensure the generated LaTeX compiles flawlessly out-of-the-box. Avoid common issues such as:
• Unmatched braces or unclosed math environments.
• Duplicate labels.
• Unescaped special characters (e.g., & % $ # _ { } ~ ^ \).
All referenced figures must exist in the provided list.

Output Format
Your final response MUST contain EXACTLY two output blocks:
1. A complete BibTeX bibliography (references.bib)
2. A complete LaTeX paper (template.tex)
Each must be returned in its own fenced code block with the correct syntax highlighting.

evaluator.name: single_agent_user.txt
evaluator.text:
Your task is to generate a complete research paper using the materials below.
You must produce:
1. A BibTeX bibliography file (references.bib)
2. The full LaTeX paper (template.tex)

Instructions
• Use the research idea and experimental logs to construct a coherent, rigorous ML paper.
• For related work and baselines:
  – Search for and include influential papers published up until {cutoff_date}.
  – Incorporate relevant literature and add the corresponding BibTeX entries to references.bib.
  – Do NOT hallucinate papers or reference keys; all citation entries must be real.
• In the LaTeX paper, cite papers using \cite{} with keys that match exactly with your entries in references.bib.
• Do not fabricate experimental results or make claims unsupported by the logs.

Materials
Here are all the raw research materials to assist with the writing process:

[RESEARCH IDEA]
{idea_text}

[EXPERIMENTAL LOGS]
{experimental_log_text}

[AVAILABLE FIGURES]
{figures_prompt_text}
Figures are located in the figures/ directory and should be referenced appropriately in the paper using standard \includegraphics commands.

[LATEX TEMPLATE]
{template_text}

Response Format
Return EXACTLY TWO fenced code blocks.
1. First code block: the BibTeX file:
```bibtex
@article{example2023,
title={Example Title},
author={Author, First},
journal={Example Journal},
year={2023}
}
```
2. Second code block: the generated LaTeX paper:
```latex
% The complete LaTeX paper here
```
The final paper must be coherent, highly polished, and scientifically accurate.

system.name: researchworld
system.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.2.0, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.2.0)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one agent per role through acpx's ACP adapter in the role's sandbox container

network.search: the shared search tool (MCP server rwe-search in every sandbox) through the same shield
network.web_access: every request of every role through the run's shield proxy, HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy with the shield's CA: the same URL, keyword, id and date rules as the other systems, the shield logs each URL; no direct way out, server-side search and remote tools off (Issue #73)

tools.permissions: acpx --approve-all --non-interactive-permissions fail: every tool call the agent asks for is approved; the role's sandbox container is the boundary

preinstalled.zh: HuTian 的 system image researchworld:rwe-v4.2.0 和 worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.2.0（acpx 与各 agent 的 ACP 适配、researchworld 包的 Python、Node.js）
preinstalled.en: HuTian's system image researchworld:rwe-v4.2.0 and worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.2.0 (acpx and each agent's ACP adapter, Python with the researchworld packages, Node.js)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one sibling container (rwe-b1-agentic-scientist-agent:df83138) per agent session, started by the orchestrator

network.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
network.web_access: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.

tools.permissions: upstream's own agent settings; provider web search denied by managed settings (Claude Code permissions.deny WebSearch, Codex web_search="disabled")

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator container has the host docker socket (root-equivalent on the host).

agent.name: none
agent.how: no coding agent: a 23-stage prompt-chain pipeline over the Anthropic Messages API

network.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

tools.permissions: no tool calls (requests carry model, messages, max_tokens); generated experiments run as plain subprocesses in the container

preinstalled.zh: python:3.11 bookworm；上游代码按 PYTHONPATH 使用；pdflatex + bibtex；CPU 版 PyTorch 和 numpy、scipy、scikit-learn、pandas、matplotlib 等（constraints.txt 固定）
preinstalled.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt)

notes.model: claude-opus-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools, no thinking parameter); ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. Generated experiments run as a plain subprocess in the container.
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (for example 4096) is shared with the thinking tokens, so long outputs can still be cut short.
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE and RWE_EFFORT switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s, refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

preinstalled.zh: python:3.11 bookworm；上游代码按 PYTHONPATH 使用；pdflatex + bibtex；CPU 版 PyTorch 和 numpy、scipy、scikit-learn、pandas、matplotlib 等（constraints.txt 固定）
preinstalled.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt)

notes.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools, no thinking parameter); ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. Generated experiments run as a plain subprocess in the container.
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (for example 4096) is shared with the thinking tokens, so long outputs can still be cut short.
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE and RWE_EFFORT switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s, refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
